runCaptures_none_after_run.statement: theorem runCaptures_none_after_run {H : HTy} {R Q : RefTy} {E F : Ty} (hp mid : Heap H) (r : HRef H R) (a : ArrTy R E) (xs : List SnapshotArgs) (q : HRef H Q) (b : ArrTy Q F) (ys : List SnapshotArgs) (hq : runCaptures hp q b ys=some mid) : runCaptures mid r a xs=none ↔ runCaptures hp r a xs=none

runCaptures_target_eq_of_input_eq.statement: theorem runCaptures_target_eq_of_input_eq {H : HTy} {R : RefTy} {E : Ty} (hp hq out out' : Heap H) (r : HRef H R) (a : ArrTy R E) (xs : List SnapshotArgs) (hin : hp.get r=hq.get r) (ho : runCaptures hp r a xs=some out) (ho' : runCaptures hq r a xs=some out') : out.get r=out'.get r

runCaptures_disjoint_outputs_eq.statement: theorem runCaptures_disjoint_outputs_eq {H : HTy} {R Q : RefTy} {E F : Ty} (hp mr mq left right : Heap H) (r : HRef H R) (a : ArrTy R E) (xs : List SnapshotArgs) (q : HRef H Q) (b : ArrTy Q F) (ys : List SnapshotArgs) (hne : r.id≠q.id) (hr : runCaptures hp r a xs=some mr) (hq : runCaptures hp q b ys=some mq) (hl : runCaptures mr q b ys=some left) (ht : runCaptures mq r a xs=some right) : left=right

runCaptures_disjoint_comm.statement: theorem runCaptures_disjoint_comm {H : HTy} {R Q : RefTy} {E F : Ty} (hp : Heap H) (r : HRef H R) (a : ArrTy R E) (xs : List SnapshotArgs) (q : HRef H Q) (b : ArrTy Q F) (ys : List SnapshotArgs) (hne : r.id≠q.id) : (runCaptures hp r a xs).bind (fun mid => runCaptures mid q b ys)= (runCaptures hp q b ys).bind (fun mid => runCaptures mid r a xs)

runCaptures_disjoint_success.statement: theorem runCaptures_disjoint_success {H : HTy} {R Q : RefTy} {E F : Ty} (hp : Heap H) (r : HRef H R) (a : ArrTy R E) (xs : List SnapshotArgs) (q : HRef H Q) (b : ArrTy Q F) (ys : List SnapshotArgs) (hne : r.id≠q.id) (hvr : CapturesValid (hp.len r a) xs) (hvq : CapturesValid (hp.len q b) ys) : ∃ mr mq out, runCaptures hp r a xs=some mr ∧ runCaptures hp q b ys=some mq ∧ runCaptures mr q b ys=some out ∧ runCaptures mq r a xs=some out ∧ (∀ k,(MObj.elems a (out.get r))[k]?=(MObj.elems a (hp.get r))[captureOrigin xs k]?) ∧ (∀ k,(MObj.elems b (out.get q))[k]?=(MObj.elems b (hp.get q))[captureOrigin ys k]?) ∧ (∀ {T : RefTy} (t : HRef H T),r.id≠t.id → q.id≠t.id → out.get t=hp.get t)

runCaptures_disjoint_path.statement: theorem runCaptures_disjoint_path {C : Contract} {Γ : Ctx} {R Q : RefTy} {E F T : Ty} (σ : State C Γ) (r : HRef σ.H R) (a : ArrTy R E) (xs : List SnapshotArgs) (q : HRef σ.H Q) (b : ArrTy Q F) (ys : List SnapshotArgs) (hne : r.id≠q.id) (mr mq left right : Heap σ.H) (hr : runCaptures σ.heap r a xs=some mr) (hq : runCaptures σ.heap q b ys=some mq) (hl : runCaptures mr q b ys=some left) (ht : runCaptures mq r a xs=some right) (path : MPath C Γ T) : path.mvalT (σ.withHeap left)=path.mvalT (σ.withHeap right)

runtime_schedules.statement: theorem runtime_schedules (n : Nat) (hn : n+3<2^256) (xs ys : List SnapshotArgs) (hx : CapturesValid (n+3) xs) (hy : CapturesValid (n+3) ys) : ∃ mr mq out : Heap H, runCaptures (hp n hn) parent0 .dyn xs=some mr ∧ runCaptures (hp n hn) parent1 .dyn ys=some mq ∧ runCaptures mr parent1 .dyn ys=some out ∧ runCaptures mq parent0 .dyn xs=some out ∧ MObj.elems .dyn (mr.get parent1)=old1 n ∧ MObj.elems .dyn (mq.get parent0)=old0 n ∧ (∀ k,(MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent0))[k]?=(old0 n)[captureOrigin xs k]?) ∧ (∀ k,(MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent1))[k]?=(old1 n)[captureOrigin ys k]?) ∧ [MObj.elems .dyn ((hp n hn).get leaf0),MObj.elems .dyn ((hp n hn).get leaf1), MObj.elems .dyn (mr.get leaf0),MObj.elems .dyn (mr.get leaf1), MObj.elems .dyn (mq.get leaf0),MObj.elems .dyn (mq.get leaf1), MObj.elems .dyn (out.get leaf0),MObj.elems .dyn (out.get leaf1),MObj.elems .dyn (out.get neighbor)]= [[true,false],[false,true],[true,false],[false,true],[true,false],[false,true],[true,false],[false,true],[true,false,true]]

both_material.statement: theorem both_material (n : Nat) (hn : n+3<2^256) : ∃ mr mq out : Heap H, runCaptures (hp n hn) parent0 .dyn [first]=some mr ∧ runCaptures (hp n hn) parent1 .dyn [first]=some mq ∧ runCaptures mr parent1 .dyn [first]=some out ∧ runCaptures mq parent0 .dyn [first]=some out ∧ [MObj.elems .dyn ((hp n hn).get parent0),MObj.elems .dyn ((hp n hn).get parent1), MObj.elems .dyn (mr.get parent0),MObj.elems .dyn (mr.get parent1), MObj.elems .dyn (mq.get parent0),MObj.elems .dyn (mq.get parent1), MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent0),MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent1)]= [old0 n,old1 n,[leaf0,leaf0,leaf1]++List.replicate n leaf0,old1 n, old0 n,[leaf1,leaf1,leaf0]++List.replicate n leaf1, [leaf0,leaf0,leaf1]++List.replicate n leaf0,[leaf1,leaf1,leaf0]++List.replicate n leaf1] ∧ MObj.elems .dyn (out.get leaf0)=[true,false] ∧ MObj.elems .dyn (out.get leaf1)=[false,true] ∧ MObj.elems .dyn (out.get neighbor)=[true,false,true] ∧ (MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent0)).map HRef.id=[0,0,1]++List.replicate n 0 ∧ (MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent1)).map HRef.id=[1,1,0]++List.replicate n 1

late_rejection.statement: theorem late_rejection (n : Nat) (hn : n+3<2^256) : ∃ mr mq : Heap H, runCaptures (hp n hn) parent0 .dyn [first]=some mr ∧ runCaptures (hp n hn) parent1 .dyn [first]=some mq ∧ checkedCaptureOverwrite mr parent0 .dyn parent0 .dyn 1 0 0=none ∧ runCaptures (hp n hn) parent0 .dyn [first,(1,0,0)]=none ∧ runCaptures mq parent0 .dyn [first,(1,0,0)]=none ∧ (runCaptures (hp n hn) parent0 .dyn [first,(1,0,0)]).bind (fun mid => runCaptures mid parent1 .dyn [first])= (runCaptures (hp n hn) parent1 .dyn [first]).bind (fun mid => runCaptures mid parent0 .dyn [first,(1,0,0)])

empty_endpoints.statement: theorem empty_endpoints (n : Nat) (hn : n+3<2^256) : runCaptures (hp n hn) parent0 .dyn [(n+3,n+3,n+3)]=some (hp n hn) ∧ runCaptures (hp n hn) parent1 .dyn [(n+3,n+3,n+3)]=some (hp n hn)

same_parent_negative.statement: theorem same_parent_negative (n : Nat) (hn : n+3<2^256) : ∃ out : Heap H, runCaptures (hp n hn) parent0 .dyn [first,repair]=some (hp n hn) ∧ runCaptures (hp n hn) parent0 .dyn [repair,first]=some out ∧ MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent0)=[leaf1,leaf1,leaf1]++List.replicate n leaf0 ∧ out≠hp n hn

boundary33.statement: theorem boundary33 : ∃ mr mq out : Heap H, runCaptures (hp 30 (by decide)) parent0 .dyn [first]=some mr ∧ runCaptures (hp 30 (by decide)) parent1 .dyn [first]=some mq ∧ runCaptures mr parent1 .dyn [first]=some out ∧ runCaptures mq parent0 .dyn [first]=some out ∧ (MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent0))[32]?=some leaf0 ∧ (MObj.elems .dyn (out.get parent1))[32]?=some leaf1

material_primitive.statement: theorem material_primitive : ∃ mr mq out : Heap H, runCaptures hp r .dyn [first]=some mr ∧ runCaptures hp q .dyn [first]=some mq ∧ runCaptures mr q .dyn [first]=some out ∧ runCaptures mq r .dyn [first]=some out ∧ [MObj.elems .dyn (hp.get r),MObj.elems .dyn (hp.get q), MObj.elems .dyn (mr.get r),MObj.elems .dyn (mr.get q), MObj.elems .dyn (mq.get r),MObj.elems .dyn (mq.get q), MObj.elems .dyn (out.get r),MObj.elems .dyn (out.get q),MObj.elems .dyn (out.get neighbor)]= [[true,false,false],[false,true,true],[true,true,false],[false,true,true], [true,false,false],[false,false,true],[true,true,false],[false,false,true],[true,false]]

fixed_shared_paths.statement: theorem fixed_shared_paths (n : Nat) : ∃ mr mq left right : Heap (H n), runCaptures (hp n) (parent0 n) .fixed [first]=some mr ∧ runCaptures (hp n) (parent1 n) .fixed [first]=some mq ∧ runCaptures mr (parent1 n) .fixed [first]=some left ∧ runCaptures mq (parent0 n) .fixed [first]=some right ∧ [MObj.elems .fixed ((hp n).get (parent0 n)),MObj.elems .fixed ((hp n).get (parent1 n)), MObj.elems .fixed (mr.get (parent0 n)),MObj.elems .fixed (mr.get (parent1 n)), MObj.elems .fixed (mq.get (parent0 n)),MObj.elems .fixed (mq.get (parent1 n)), MObj.elems .fixed (left.get (parent0 n)),MObj.elems .fixed (left.get (parent1 n)), MObj.elems .fixed (right.get (parent0 n)),MObj.elems .fixed (right.get (parent1 n))]= [old0 n,old1 n,changed0 n,old1 n,old0 n,changed1 n,changed0 n,changed1 n,changed0 n,changed1 n] ∧ (selected0 n).mvalT (state n)=.ok (leaf1 n) ∧ (selected1 n).mvalT (state n)=.ok (leaf0 n) ∧ (selected0 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap left)=.ok (leaf0 n) ∧ (selected0 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap right)=.ok (leaf0 n) ∧ (selected1 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap left)=.ok (leaf1 n) ∧ (selected1 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap right)=.ok (leaf1 n) ∧ (nested0 n).mvalT (state n)=.ok false ∧ (nested1 n).mvalT (state n)=.ok true ∧ (nested0 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap left)=.ok true ∧ (nested0 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap right)=.ok true ∧ (nested1 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap left)=.ok false ∧ (nested1 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap right)=.ok false ∧ (selected0 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap left)=(selected0 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap right) ∧ (nested1 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap left)=(nested1 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap right) ∧ [MObj.elems .dyn (left.get (leaf0 n)),MObj.elems .dyn (left.get (leaf1 n)), MObj.elems .dyn (left.get (neighbor n)),MObj.elems .dyn (right.get (leaf0 n)), MObj.elems .dyn (right.get (leaf1 n)),MObj.elems .dyn (right.get (neighbor n))]= stale_initial_path_negative.statement: theorem stale_initial_path_negative (n : Nat) : ∃ mr mq left right : Heap (H n), runCaptures (hp n) (parent0 n) .fixed [first]=some mr ∧ runCaptures (hp n) (parent1 n) .fixed [first]=some mq ∧ runCaptures mr (parent1 n) .fixed [first]=some left ∧ runCaptures mq (parent0 n) .fixed [first]=some right ∧ (selected0 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap left)≠(selected0 n).mvalT (state n) ∧ (nested0 n).mvalT ((state n).withHeap right)≠(nested0 n).mvalT (state n)

length33.statement: theorem length33 : ∃ mr mq left right : Heap (H 30), runCaptures (hp 30) (parent0 30) .fixed [first]=some mr ∧ runCaptures (hp 30) (parent1 30) .fixed [first]=some mq ∧ runCaptures mr (parent1 30) .fixed [first]=some left ∧ runCaptures mq (parent0 30) .fixed [first]=some right ∧ (hp 30).len (parent0 30) .fixed=33 ∧ (selected0 30).mvalT ((state 30).withHeap left)=.ok (leaf0 30)

literal_empty_endpoints.statement: theorem literal_empty_endpoints : MObj.elems .fixed (hp.get fixedEmpty)=[] ∧ MObj.elems .dyn (hp.get dynamicEmpty)=[] ∧ runCaptures hp fixedEmpty .fixed [(0,0,0)]=some hp ∧ runCaptures hp dynamicEmpty .dyn [(0,0,0)]=some hp ∧ (runCaptures hp fixedEmpty .fixed [(0,0,0)]).bind (fun mid => runCaptures mid dynamicEmpty .dyn [(0,0,0)])=some hp ∧ (runCaptures hp dynamicEmpty .dyn [(0,0,0)]).bind (fun mid => runCaptures mid fixedEmpty .fixed [(0,0,0)])=some hp ∧ (runCaptures hp fixedEmpty .fixed [(0,0,0)]).bind (fun mid => runCaptures mid dynamicEmpty .dyn [(0,0,0)])= (runCaptures hp dynamicEmpty .dyn [(0,0,0)]).bind (fun mid => runCaptures mid fixedEmpty .fixed [(0,0,0)]) ∧ MObj.elems .dyn (hp.get leaf)=[true,false]

literal_empty_bounds.statement: theorem literal_empty_bounds : checkedCaptureOverwrite hp fixedEmpty .fixed fixedEmpty .fixed 0 1 0=none ∧ checkedCaptureOverwrite hp dynamicEmpty .dyn dynamicEmpty .dyn 0 1 0=none ∧ runCaptures hp fixedEmpty .fixed [(0,1,0)]=none ∧ runCaptures hp dynamicEmpty .dyn [(0,1,0)]=none ∧ hp.index fixedEmpty .fixed zero=none ∧ hp.index dynamicEmpty .dyn zero=none ∧ fixedPath.mvalT state=.error .revert ∧ dynamicPath.mvalT state=.error .revert
